== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Del'rek of the [[Shann]] is a powerful combatant and a member of the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]]. A sacred elephant capable of assuming human form, Del'rek possesses a massive stature that significantly exceeds the height of humans. In this humanoid state, the entity retains physical traits such as tusks. Del'rek is a highly skilled martial artist; one notable master described a duel with Del'rek as an incredibly intense encounter that provided more value than a decade of solitary training. Additionally, Del'rek is proficient with weaponry, specifically utilizing a spear that causes space to tremble when wielded.}}
